caption: The image depicts a textile or woven coverlet with a primarily dark blue and white color scheme. In the top right quadrant, there is a large central geometric medallion with a starburst pattern surrounded by various stars, floral motifs, and leaf-like shapes, all arranged symmetrically. The left portion of the textile is vertically divided into smaller panels featuring stylized trees with circular foliage, perched birds, and small human figures beneath the trees. In the lower left corner, there is a depiction of a lion facing forward, situated above the text "HENDERSON, N.Y. 1836." To the right of the lion, the border includes more tree motifs with birds on the branches, and more tiny human figures beneath the trees. Along the vertical edge adjacent to the lion, the text reads "LIVIA PIERCE" and "HENDERSON, N.Y." The entire composition is created from alternating dark blue and white contrasting threads, giving a checkerboard and negative-space effect to the overall design.
title: Tyler Coverlet (Section)
